reviews.t: Didn't work for me, but not a bad product
reviews.x: Unfortunately I was not a fan of this dry shampoo... I have very fine hair, but a LOT of it. I am also just a very oily person. This means that within 24 hrs my hair starts to look limp and greasy so dry shampoo is a necessity for me. I used Oscar Blandi dry shampoo (the non-aerosole version) to great success, but it seems to have been discontinued (bummer!). So I decided to try this dry shampoo.  Pros: Its a decent amount/size for the price and the organic thing is nice. Also, the bottle was ea

reviews.t: A natural dry shampoo that does the trick!
reviews.x: Spent a while looking for an all-natural dry shampoo, as I wasn't comfortable spraying chemicals in my hair. This product is it!  The powder has a light rosy scent--nothing overpowering. As a woman in my early twenties, I was concerned it'd smell like something our grandparents would wear, but that's not the case. Even if you think differently, the scent dissipates rather quickly.  I suggest using this before bed, or before your hair gets really oily, as it does a better job of preventing oiline

reviews.t: I used it this morning and my hair looks great. It does take a little more time to ...
reviews.x: Exactly what I was looking for. Hair powder doesn't have noxious chemicals, absorbs right away, no smell that I can detect. And it works without leaving flakes all over, which has happened to me with lots of other dry shampoos. I used it this morning and my hair looks great. It does take a little more time to apply than a spray, since you are shaking on the powder, but if you want to avoid spraying your head with butane - which the other spray dry shampoos contain, I think it's a good trade off.

reviews.t: Nice smell, but ineffective
reviews.x: I was very excited to try a more natural dry shampoo. I usually use Batiste, and was happy to see that this product was talc, phthalate, and paraben free. Unfortunately, the size of this product took me by surprise, which is no one's fault but my own. However, I still had high hopes for the product. I tried the product this morning on second day hair. reviews.t: Works as good as batiste with out the residue and without wasting product.
reviews.x: Update: I’ve had the same bottle for about 3-4 months and it’s only half way gone. I used to go thru 1 bottle of batiste every 1-2 weeks.  This works for me and I’ve always struggled with blonde oily hair within less than 24 hours of washing it and yes I’ve always done what you’re supposed to with oily hair (wash it less, use conditioner on ends only, use shampoo for oily hair, etc.). I used to only use Batiste bc that’s the only one that would work for me. I’ve been trying to use more organic b

reviews.t: OK for a dry shampoo, but scent is overpowering
reviews.x: Smells like a grandma's powder room. I really can't get past how strong the fragrance is. Is it really necessary? Other than that, I like that it isn't an aerosol. I will probably just save this for when I go camping. I don't think I can tolerate the intense odor for even occasional use at home.

reviews.t: Works ok, strange scent
reviews.x: Works ok, not as great as Batiste, but better than some other dry shampoos I've tried.  Batiste is still the gold standard for dry shampoo for me, but I've been wanting to switch to a non-aerosol version.  So far, the Captain Blankenship has worked the best of the few non-aerosol ones I've tried.  It does not give the same volume as Batiste, and by the end of the day my hair looks pretty flat and limp.  I have long, thick hair though so perhaps this will work better for someone with shorter, fin

reviews.t: Great dry shampoo - will last you much longer than sprays!
reviews.x: I've tried quite a few dry shampoos on Amazon and this is my favorite.  I have thin hair but I have a lot of it and my scalp shows oil within 18 hours of washing.  No overwhelming smell and does what it is supposed to. I usually put this in my hair before I sleep and wake up with no oil. I am a natural strawberry blonde and have no issues getting the white powder out of my hair if I need to use this in a pinch.  The only thing is I wish the applicator was a little better - I find it is hard to g

reviews.t: It smells fantastic too!
reviews.x: I recently purchased this from another retailer and after the first use I knew I needed to keep this product stocked so I checked Amazon and sure enough...it is available here.  As a licensed cosmetologist for 40 yrs I have tried many products and this is an 'essential' one especially with all the oils we now incorporate in our hair products to get the shine and conditioning but a negative effect is that our scalps get much oiler faster...this is a solution!  It smells fantastic too!

reviews.t: Eco friendly, smells great, works well!
reviews.x: This stuff holds up to my spray dry shampoo and last so much longer! I have been using this container for a month! This is amazing because I was going through my dry shampoo like crazy as a new convert! There is a slight learning curve when it comes to applying to the hair, but it's not hard to use. I prefer to use my dry shampoo at night and let it soak everything up while I sleep anyways so any sort of white color present doesn't bother me because it will be gone by the morning!

reviews.t: Great, natural dry shampoo
reviews.x: Really like this product so far! I was attracted to it because of the natural ingredients. I read the reviews about a strong fragrance, but I don't think it's overpowering at all. I have thick dark brown hair and the white powder absorbs just fine. It has done a great job keeping my hair from getting oily between washes. I'm excited to try more products from this company!

reviews.t: Mermaid Hair
reviews.x: I'm docking one star for how small the product is in comparison to price. However, packaging is adorable and the pure ingredients are what win me over. It has the consistency of baby powder with a little more grit. The rosè geranium scent is soft and wonderful. Also, a little seems to go a long way. reviews.t: Meh. It's okay.
reviews.x: Pros: Makes hair less greasy. Natural ingredients.  Cons: Price is high for amount of product. Application difficult. Odd packaging. Leaves ends of hair feeling coarse.  Personally, indifferent on smell.  I purchased this product because I recently switched to the "no poo" movement. I have been water-washing my hair two to three times a week for the last month and a half and loving the results. I needed a dry shampoo for some of those in-between days where my hair looked a little greasy

reviews.t: Well worth the cost
reviews.x: The powder is pretty good and is easier to apply than I expected. The container was small, but I can already see that it will last me much longer than the dry shampoo sprays I used before. It smells good and and makes me feel much safer about using it than all the butane in the sprays. It does the job as far as dry shampooing. Will it make your hair feel like it's just been washed? No, no dry shampoo will be able to do that - you have to eventually wash your hair. But it will absorb the oil and

reviews.t: Looking for natural organic dry shampoo
reviews.x: Was looking for a natural organic dry shampoo, after using mostly spray aerosols products with really strong scents, I wanted something natural, in a powder form. I had seen the Captain Blakenship  dry shampoo on a few sites before, so wanted to try it out, the cost was relatively more affordable then some other brands out there. So far, I love it. The scent is subtle but very nice, container lid has a few different ways of sprinkling the product out depending on how much you want to use. I have

reviews.t: Works good and quickly
reviews.x: I was looking for a dry shampoo that didn't have all the scary ingredients of previous aerosol versions I've used in the past, and this fit the bill! It's a pretty small size but seems like it will last a while. It doesn't take much to make your hair looks nice and clean again. I have pretty oily hair so this works nicely so I don't have to wash it everyday. It works quickly and has a very light clean scent, I actually wish it had a bit more of a scent but that might just be me. Overall I'm happ

reviews.t: Great product in a convenient package with ingredients I recognize!
reviews.x: I admit I ordered this product because I loved the "mermaid" part of the name and because the ingredients were ones I could recognize.  I will order again because it works.  My hair--blonde by Aveda--looks great and does have more volume between complete washings.  I am planning several trips this year and this Captain Blankenship product will be traveling with me for the quick lifts and for in-depth pick-me-ups between shampoo/conditionings.  The rose geranium scent is subtle and refres

reviews.t: Works great without the toxic ingredients
reviews.x: It basically looks like baby powder but if you get it on your clothes it rubs off way easier without leaving subtle white streaks. Does the job just don't love the application process as its kind of a mess. But once you get it rubbed throughout the greasy parts of your hair, it works great and makes it look just washed. Smells good, not too strong. Wish it was a spray like other brands but love that there are not any toxic chemicals and its all natural.

reviews.t: Nice smell morphs into weird smell after mixing with hair
reviews.x: This definitely does absorb oil pretty well, but the smell is just awful. At first, in your hand, it smells nice. A bit of lavender and something else. However, when sprinkled into my hair, the lavender smell completely disappears. What's left definitely reminds me of old people, as another review so eloquently put it. Must be due to mixing with the oils in my hair.

reviews.t: Seems like the solution I am looking for!
reviews.x: Just tried this for the first time after sampling the aerosol varieties. I was specifically looking for an organic/natural product. I have only used it once so far and I do think it will take a bit of getting used to applying since it's a powder and not a spray. However, first impressions are positive! I liked the smell and didn't find it overwhelming in the least; in fact, it's very subtle. My hair doesn't feel sticky or dull (as sometimes happened with the other dry shampoos I have tried); it

reviews.t: Best dry shampoo!
reviews.x: I've only used this dry shampoo once so far so I will definitely update after a couple more uses, but so far I absolutely love it.  I've used many different dry shampoos before, each time finding things I like about it, but never really finding a reason to consistently stay with a product. One of the issues I've had is I have a sensitive eyes and other dry shampoo products have caused my eyes to water after use, but I had no such experience with this one. Additionally, the scent of this product

reviews.t: My search is over! Glory be!
reviews.x: I have spent some time trying out dry shampoos since the powder I swore by was discontinued (Naturelle Biotera only makes a spray dry shampoo now and it doesn't make my hair feel clean). I am so happy with the Mermaid powder and in love with the sweet rose scent bonus. I can get away with washing my hair once a week again! The most important part about this dry shampoo is that it makes my hair feel clean after application! I have been searching far and wide and other products just let me down. I

reviews.t: Wonderful product and lovely smell!
reviews.x: Just received this product a few days ago and used it once. The powder has very pleasant and elegant smell.  While applying it to my hair, I accidentally poured some over my dress, which was black, and I was worried the powder would leave some whitish residue on the fabric. However, to my surprise I was able to dust off the powder completely and had no white-powdering mark on my clothes.  Product kept my hair fluffy and airy without flattening all day long.  So far so good!!

reviews.t: but even a little dallop of it was very "powdery" in that it poofed out and I ended up breathing it in (which can't be g
reviews.x: The packaging right off was not what I expected. (A salt and pepper shaker. One that was very hard to open. My hubby managed to and then plastic stopper part fell down into the product.) The powder itself is lightweight and it worked well. The scent was pleasing...but even a little dallop of it was very "powdery" in that it poofed out and I ended up breathing it in (which can't be good for the lungs) when using it for the first time. I will seek out alternatives....

reviews.t: Keeps my hair feeling fresh and go longer between washes
reviews.x: I've only used it a few times now and I know others commented on the scent. Basically, I think that it may be a bit strong, but the scent itself doesn't bother me at all, and the more I use it, the more I get used to it and like it. To me, it has a natural and fresh scent. It also seems to fade in as the day goes on or is brushed out. It does do the trick and I've been able to go from washing my hair every other day to about 4 or 5 days before washing again.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the powder effective at absorbing oil and keeping hair from looking greasy, often working as well as spray dry shampoos.
Reviewers appreciate the natural, chemical-free ingredients and non-aerosol powder form.
The product lasts much longer than spray dry shampoos, with several noting a single container lasts months.
Opinions on the scent are divided: some find it light and pleasant, while others find it overpowering or like a grandma's powder room.
Some reviewers find the container small for the price and note a learning curve or difficult application.
